वि॑-स्रस्त mfn. fallen asunder or down, unfastened, untied, loosened, detached, AV. &c. &c.
dishevelled (as hair), HPariś.
slackened, relaxed, MBh.
वि-स्रस्त—कुसुम-स्रज् mfn. one whose garland of flowers has fallen off, Kathās.
वि-स्रस्त—चेतस् mfn. one whose spirit is dejected, MBh. (B. वि-ध्वस्त-च्˚)
वि-स्रस्त—पौंस्न mfn. one whose manhood is broken or impaired, BhP.
वि-स्रस्त—बन्धन mfn. having bonds or fetters unfastened, Kathās.
वि-स्रस्त—वसन mfn. having loosened garments, ib.
वि-स्रस्त—शिरोरुहाम्बर mfn. having dishevelled hair and loosened garments, BhP.
वि-स्रस्त—स्रग्-विभूषण mfn. one whose garland and ornaments have fallen off, MBh.
वि-स्रस्त—हार mfn. one whose necklace has slipped off, MW.
वि-स्रस्˚ताङ्ग mfn. having a languid body or relaxed limbs, MBh.
वि-स्र॑स्य mfn. to be loosened or untied, TS.
वि-स्रवन्-मिश्र॑ mfn. (pr. p. of वि-√ स्रु + म्˚) having blood streaming forth (on it), ŚBr.
वि-˚स्रावित mfn. (fr. id.) wasted away, caused to flow out, bled, ib.
वि-˚स्रावितव्य mfn. (fr. id.) = next, MW.
वि-˚स्राव्य mfn. (fr. id.) to be made to flow, MBh. (cf. अ-विस्र्˚)
dissolving, melting, becoming liquid (-ता f.), Cat.
to be bled, requiring bleeding, Suśr.
वि-˚स्राव्य—ता f.
वि-स्रु॑ह् f. (prob. fr. √ स्रुह् = रुध्, to grow; cf. वी-रुध्) a plant, shoot (?), RV. v, 44, 3 (read वि-स्रुहाम्); vi, 7, 6 (Nir. आपः, Sāy. नद्यः).
वि-√ स्वप् P. -स्वपिति (pf. -सुष्वाप), Vop.
वि-षुप्त mfn. fallen asleep, sleeping, Kāṭh.; ĀpŚr. (cf. Pāṇ. viii, 3, 88, Sch.)
वीसल-देव m. N. of a king, Inscr.
